title: Monkey dancing
svg:

  <circle cx='44' cy='28' r='1.5' fill='#fff6e0'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='28' r='1.5' fill='#fff6e0'/>

  <path d='M43 38 Q50 45 57 38' stroke='#8a5316' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
